message: Approved implementation scope and plan. Verification: full Go race suite, vet and build passed. Pinned lint passed. Actual a706b71 and 36efd04 databases upgraded and ordinary claim/resume/revise APIs passed. PostgreSQL gates and concurrent receipts passed. Claude resumed workflow is externally blocked by weekly quota. Human external pushes currently wait safely for a matching tester verdict and require manual request changes to retest.

FINDING: The approved plan step “child integration through existing PR monitor” limits automated merging to child tickets, while `spec.md` explicitly says “Keep final merge manual.” The new `MergeFinal` service, `/api/epics/{id}/merge-final` API/UI actions, `AutoMergeFinal` option, and direct `github.MergePullRequest` call automate the final merge. Remove final auto-merge behavior and retain only a human-managed final handoff.

Spec: not satisfied. The unresolved spec-adherence finding identifies final auto-merge behavior that contradicts “Keep final merge manual.”

Scope minimality: not satisfied. `MergeFinal`, `AutoMergeFinal`, final-merge API/UI routes, GitHub wiring, documentation, and associated tests exceed the approved child-integration scope.
